## Analyzers (1)

### IVRE `v1.0`
Fetch details from an IVRE instance.

- **Author:** Pierre Lalet
- **License:** AGPL-V3
- **Data Types:** `autonomous-system`, `certificate_hash`, `domain`, `fqdn`, `ip`, `network`, `port`, `user-agent`
- **Configuration:** [View config](https://github.com/nusantara-self/strangebee-integrations/blob/main/.upstream/cortex/analyzers/IVRE/IVRE.json)
